name: Eufy Doorbell Intercom
description: Rings the panel when someone presses a Eufy doorbell, and opens a full-screen viewer with a Eufy camera's live picture, through the eufy-security-ws bridge (the Home Assistant add-on). Live video and listening; talking to the door is not available yet.
author: Fork of patrick11994's Reolink Doorbell Intercom (Apache-2.0)

settings.title: Bridge address
settings.description: IP address or hostname of Home Assistant, where the eufy-security-ws add-on runs, for example 192.168.1.50 or homeassistant.local.

settings.title: Bridge port
settings.description: The add-on's Port setting. 3002 unless you changed it.

settings.title: Doorbell serial number
settings.description: Serial number of the Eufy doorbell whose button rings this panel, as the Eufy app shows it (for example T8200N0...). Only this device rings.

settings.title: Camera serial number
settings.description: Serial number of the Eufy camera whose live picture the call screen shows. It can be the doorbell itself or another camera shared with the account the bridge uses.

settings.title: Extra snapshot source (HA image entity)
settings.description: Optional. The doorbell's own event pictures arrive from the bridge by themselves; this adds a Home Assistant image entity as a second source, for example image.front_door_event_image.

settings.title: Home Assistant URL
settings.description: Where the plugin fetches the snapshot from, for example http://homeassistant.local:8123. Empty uses the bridge address on port 8123.

settings.title: Show the snapshot for (minutes)
settings.description: A snapshot older than this is not shown, so an old picture does not pass for the person at the door now. 15 by default.

settings.title: Name
settings.description: Shown at the top of the viewer. Empty shows Front door, in the plugin's language.

settings.title: Ring on this device
settings.description: Off: a press does not play the chime, wake the screen or open the call screen here. Last ring and the Doorbell pressed trigger still follow presses, and opening the call screen by hand still works. Also a switch in Home Assistant, as are Play a chime, Wake the screen and Chime volume.

settings.title: Play a chime
settings.description: A ding-dong when the button is pressed.

settings.title: Chime volume
settings.description: How loud the chime itself is. 40 is a soft chime, 100 as loud as it goes.

settings.title: Chime sound
settings.description: Which Android volume the chime follows. Pick Media if your device has only one volume slider, or Alarm to be heard over a quiet ring volume.

settings.title: Pause music
settings.description: Pauses the kiosk's music during a doorbell call, and resumes it when the viewer closes. Only music that was playing is paused and resumed. At the ring pauses on the button press; At Speaker or Answer keeps it playing until you listen or talk. Opened by hand, it pauses once the speaker or microphone is on.

settings.title: Wake the screen
settings.description: Turn the screen on and close the screensaver when the button is pressed.

settings.title: Restore the screen
settings.description: After a ring woke the screen, put it back once the call screen closes: turn it off again, or start the screensaver again. The dashboard stays as it was. When not answered skips this when someone pressed Speaker or Answer.

settings.title: Call volume
settings.description: How loud the doorbell plays on the panel. The viewer has a slider for it too.

settings.title: Microphone
settings.description: Which Android microphone source talks to the door. Automatic takes the first that opens, Camcorder first. Pick another if the door does not hear you.

settings.title: Talk mode
settings.description: Hands free keeps the microphone open during a call. Push to talk sends your voice only while you hold the microphone button, and turns the door's sound down meanwhile, so the door cannot hear itself: for devices where Voice communication does not stop the echo, such as an Echo Show.

settings.title: Microphone sample rate
settings.description: The rate the microphone is opened at. Automatic tries 16000 Hz first, then 48000 Hz and 8000 Hz. Pick another if the door hears noise.

settings.title: Android call mode
settings.description: Switches Android to call mode on the loudspeaker during a call, which most devices need for echo cancelling. Turn it off if sound or the microphone stops working in a call.

settings.title: Wake word muted by a call
settings.description: Managed by the plugin: brings the wake word back if a call was cut off.

settings.title: Music paused by a call
settings.description: Managed by the plugin: resumes the music if a call was cut off.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: For the viewer, readings and messages. Automatic follows the panel's Android language.

settings.title: Close the viewer after
settings.description: After a doorbell press, while nobody touches it; a ring around Hang up shows the time left. A touch starts it over, Speaker or Answer stop it. Opened by hand, it stays open.

settings.title: End a call after
settings.description: Once answered or opened by hand, so a forgotten call does not keep the room on the line.

settings.title: Call buttons
settings.description: The round buttons at the bottom of the call screen, in this order. Answer turns into the microphone in a call, Hang up into End call. Add a button of your own, such as one to open the door. Remove Answer and Speaker for a screen that only shows who is there. Without Hang up, a close button shows in the corner.

fields.title: Show
fields.description: In a call also counts listening with Speaker.

fields.title: Hold to run
fields.description: Runs the action only after holding the button for a moment, so it cannot be tapped by accident. For a door or a gate.

settings.title: Cards
settings.description: Cards in the viewer, above the call buttons: each runs an action you choose, such as a Home Assistant service to open the door or toggle a light, and can show the live state of a Home Assistant entity. More than fit scroll.

fields.title: Icon
fields.description: Empty follows the entity, the way Home Assistant shows it.

fields.title: State
fields.description: A Home Assistant entity whose state the card shows, such as a light, a lock or an alarm. Optional.

fields.title: Action
fields.description: What a tap does. Optional: without one the card only shows the state.

fields.title: Hold to run
fields.description: Runs the action only after holding the card for a moment, so it cannot be tapped by accident. For a door or a gate.

fields.title: Style
fields.description: Tile shows the label and the state. Button is round, like the call buttons, with the label below it.

fields.title: Colour
fields.description: Follow the state colours the card the way Home Assistant does, such as amber for a light that is on.

fields.title: Show
fields.description: In a call also counts listening with Speaker.

settings.title: Landscape column
settings.description: On a landscape screen, where the buttons and cards sit in the columns beside the picture.

buttons.title: Ring this panel now
buttons.label: Test ring
buttons.description: Rings this panel as if the doorbell was pressed: wakes the screen, chimes and opens the call screen with the camera.

buttons.title: Check the bridge and camera
buttons.label: Check
buttons.description: Connects to the bridge and asks the camera for a picture.
